name: LBG Media plc
summary: LBG Media PLC, a global online publishing house founded in 2012 and based in Manchester, United Kingdom, develops and distributes a diverse range of digital content. Its offerings include journalistic articles, exclusive celebrity interviews, documentary features, reality television programs, live political broadcasts, and influential social impact campaigns. This content is disseminated across a portfolio of distinct digital platforms, such as the news-focused LADbible, the sports-oriented SPORTbible, Gamingbible, UNILAD Adventure, UNILAD Tech, UNILAD, ODDSbible, UNILAD Sound, and Tyla.
